global_rules: Ask the smallest next necessary question.
Extract and confirm facts before calculation.
Never render final PI% unless the assess_* tool succeeds.
Keep internal IDs out of user-facing messages.
When user corrects facts, patch the structured state and reconfirm.
title: Respiratory Function

slots.question: Is this a standard respiratory assessment, occupational asthma, or asbestosis/silicosis?
Please provide any available pulmonary function values: FVC%, FEV1%, DLCO%, or VO2 max.
Which PI% within the class range should be selected, in nearest 5% increments?
For occupational asthma: does the worker require daily maintenance medication, has exposure transfer lasted at least one year, and is further improvement unlikely?
What is the minimum medication required to maintain control?
Is the radiological profusion at least 1/1?
Please confirm the extracted respiratory findings before I calculate the system-generated PI%.

conversation_rules.rule: Give more weight to objective pulmonary function tests than subjective dyspnoea.
Occupational asthma medication pathway requires daily maintenance, transfer from exposure for at least one year, and unlikely further improvement.
Radiologically definite asbestosis/silicosis with profusion at least 1/1 may receive a 10% floor.
